spans.s:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Vain, idle, unmeaning, fruitless, useless.
E.
वि privative, and फल fruit.

f. (-ता)
Unprofitableness, fruitlessness.
E.
विफल, and तल् added; also विफलत्वं.

n. (-णं)
1 Frustrating, foiling, defeating.
2 Doing any thing in vain.
E.
विफल, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Rendered vain, frustrated.
2 Done in vain.
E.
विफल, and कृत done, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Become unprofitable.
E.
विफल, and भविष्णु become, च्चि augment.

f. (-ता)
Unprofitableness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also, विफलीभविष्णुत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Become useless.
E.
विफल, and भत become, च्चि augment.
